Let me analyze this case: services ["a","b"], allow = startswith(["a"]), drop = match(["a","b"]).
L = {w : w starts with "a"} minus {"ab"} = {"a", "aa", "aaa", ...} minus "ab".

So the accepting states: after "a" (state 1) ✓ accepting; after "aa" → state 3 (accepting) ✓; after "ab" → state 4 (not accepting) ✓; the dead state 2 (not accepting) ✓.

The DFA has 5 states: 0 = empty (not accepting), 1 = "a" (accepting), 2 = dead, 3 = "aa..." (accepting), 4 = "ab..." (not accepting).

So accept = [False, True, False, True, False] ✓ — my expectation of 3 states was wrong (I forgot the "ab" branch). The implementation is correct ✓.

Let me fix the test expectation: accept.count(True) == 2 and the state after ["a","b"] is not accepting.
